title: The Witch and the Beast
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world saturated with magic, the gentle mage Ashaf and the feral, foul-mouthed Guideau work for the Order of Magical Resonance, investigating cases involving witches. Guideau is a 'beast' cursed into a female body by the witch Angela, and Ashaf carries her true form in a coffin on his back. Their hunt for Angela runs through cursed towns, a witch-hunting Church and a spreading trade in blood-fueled Forbidden Instruments.
life_message: Power over others corrupts, and loyal partnership and self-control matter more than vengeance, though justice against abusers must still be pursued.

delivery.note: Summaries show the story's view of abused power carried case by case through the pair's hunts, with witches and the Church both cast as threats.

winners_losers: Ashaf and Guideau win case by case against witches who exploit towns; tyrant witches and the Church's brutal Executioners lose sympathy.
